entries.1275ed93b2e16c99: This category operates hotels classified under the real estate business segment and is represented by JR West Hotel Development Co., Ltd. and Wakayama Terminal Building Co., Ltd. According to its history, in July 2025 JR West Hotel Development Co., Ltd. merged with Hotel Granvia Hiroshima Co., Ltd., Hotel Granvia Okayama Co., Ltd. and Nara Hotel Co., Ltd., and in October of the same year Hotel Granvia Osaka Co., Ltd. was also merged. The securities report explains that it captured demand from the Osaka-Kansai Expo and inbound tourism, and reorganized its hotel operating companies. The limited-service hotel 'Via Inn' is classified not in this category but in the Distribution Business segment. Revenue and profit for this category alone are not disclosed in the securities report.
entries.1793c4505cbbcb78: Real Estate Sales and Leasing Business
entries.17ad3ec316f5c813: This reportable segment engages in real estate sales and leasing using owned properties, as well as shopping center operation and hotel operation. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥285,762 million (up 22.8% year on year), the 2nd largest among the reportable segments; segment profit was ¥46,332 million, segment assets were ¥1,026,302 million, and capital expenditure was ¥82.5 billion. The securities report explains that operating revenue rose 22.8% year on year to ¥285.7 billion and operating income rose 19.1% to ¥46.3 billion, due to strong performance in the shopping center and hotel businesses from the opening effects of urban development projects around Osaka Station and Hiroshima Station, and the expansion of real estate sales and leasing. Segment assets are the second largest after those of the Mobility Business.
entries.3c73de52aca06fe9: Real Estate Investment and Management Business
entries.3fa2a05bad0a6efc: This is Shinkansen passenger transport. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, track distance was 937.7 km, passenger car-kilometers were 616,193 thousand km (101.8% of the previous fiscal year), passenger-kilometers were 23,092,478 thousand passenger-km (106.4%), and passenger revenue was ¥548,260 million (107.6%), of which non-commuter revenue of ¥533,638 million accounted for the great majority. The occupancy rate (passenger-kilometers divided by the product of passenger car-kilometers and average passenger capacity per car) was 48.1%, up from 46.0% in the previous fiscal year. The securities report explains that Shinkansen transport revenue rose 7.6% year on year, an increase of ¥38.8 billion to ¥548.2 billion, and that Shinkansen revenue depends mainly on the number of business and tourist travelers and is affected by the economic environment, competition with airlines and trends in inbound tourists. On safety, the company is extending seismic reinforcement and derailment prevention measures for the Sanyo Shinkansen to the entire line, and aims to complete the main measures by the end of fiscal 2027.
entries.644b70126056ff7c: This category is operated by group companies in passenger bus transport (JR Bus Chugoku Co., Ltd., West Japan JR Bus Co., Ltd.), ship operation (JR West Miyajima Ferry Co., Ltd.) and car rental and leasing (JR West Rent-a-Car & Lease Co., Ltd.). According to its history, in April 1988 the bus business was transferred to West Japan JR Bus Co., Ltd. and Chugoku JR Bus Co., Ltd. (now JR Bus Chugoku Co., Ltd.), and in April 2009 the ship business was transferred to JR West Miyajima Ferry Co., Ltd. In July 2009, two station rental car companies merged to become JR West Rent-a-Car & Lease Co., Ltd. Revenue and profit for this category alone are not disclosed in the securities report.
entries.66877b8de5f98ff4: This category operates shopping centers such as station buildings and is carried out by JR West SC Development Co., Ltd., JR West Kyoto SC Development Co., Ltd., Toyama Terminal Building Co., Ltd., Sanyo SC Development Co., Ltd., Kanazawa Terminal Development Co., Ltd., JR West Urban Development Co., Ltd., Chugoku SC Development Co., Ltd., Wakayama Station Building Co., Ltd., Shin-Osaka Station Store Co., Ltd., JR West Osaka Development Co., Ltd., JR West Sanin Development Co., Ltd., and others. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, it opened 'Kitasenri Green Place' in July, and worked on the stable operation of 'Umekita Green Place', opened in the previous fiscal year, and 'minamoa' at Hiroshima Station. Revenue and profit for this category alone are not disclosed in the securities report.
entries.69cf52608706c5b5: This reportable segment engages in retail and food and beverage sales, department store operation, and wholesale of various goods. The business details table also lists the limited-service hotel 'Via Inn' (hotel business) within this category. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥232,641 million (up 11.7% year on year), segment profit was ¥16,264 million, segment assets were ¥111,704 million, and capital expenditure was ¥3.6 billion. The securities report explains that operating revenue rose 11.7% year on year to ¥232.6 billion and operating income rose 17.6% to ¥16.2 billion, due to strong performance from the opening of stores at the Osaka-Kansai Expo Official Store, station stores, and use of 'Via Inn'.
entries.7a5b235fd06c335f: A railway company that runs Shinkansen and conventional lines in Hokuriku, Kinki, Chugoku and northern Kyushu, and also handles station buildings, shopping centers, hotels, department stores and travel agency business.
entries.82b2e5c7159b5635: This category operates the limited-service hotel 'Via Inn' and is carried out by JR West Via Inn Co., Ltd.; the securities report classifies it under the Distribution Business segment. According to its history, in April 2025 the limited-service hotel business of JR West Daily Service Net Co., Ltd. was succeeded to it through an absorption-type company split. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, it renovated the guest room interiors of Via Inn Shinagawa Oimachi and worked to improve its competitiveness. Revenue and profit for this category alone are not disclosed in the securities report.
entries.9168ab98c036b433: This category consists of group companies responsible for the construction and maintenance of facilities that support railway operations. The business details table lists rolling stock and other equipment installation (JR West Techno Co., Ltd., JR West Shinkansen Techno Co., Ltd.), machinery and other equipment installation (JR West Techsia Co., Ltd.), electrical work (JR West Electric Tech Co., Ltd., JR West Electric System Co., Ltd., Tetsuden Co., Ltd.), cleaning and maintenance (JR West Mentec Co., Ltd., JR West Chugoku Mentec Co., Ltd., JR West Kanazawa Mentec Co., Ltd.), and construction (Daitetsu Kogyo Co., Ltd., JR West Rail Tech Co., Ltd., JR West Built Co., Ltd., Kosei Construction Co., Ltd.). Kosei Construction Co., Ltd. is an equity-method affiliate. Tetsuden Co., Ltd. changed its trade name to T-SoLinx Co., Ltd. on June 1, 2026. In addition, JR West Customer Relations Co., Ltd., JR West Transport Service Co., Ltd. and JR West Chugoku Transport Service Co., Ltd., which are listed under 'Other' in the table, are also listed among the main related companies of the Mobility Business. Revenue and profit for this category alone are not disclosed in the securities report.
entries.977651dfe36ff7c5: This category engages in real estate sales and leasing; the business details table lists real estate sales and leasing business (the company, JR West Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., JR West Properties Co., Ltd.) and real estate leasing business (Kyoto Station Building Development Co., Ltd., JR West Station City Co., Ltd.). The securities report explains that, in addition to business promotion in Japan, it worked on developing multi-unit rental housing in Houston, Texas, United States, and Sydney, Australia. Revenue and profit for this category alone are not disclosed in the securities report.
entries.9b50893aa70b05be: This is passenger transport on conventional lines, which the securities report presents divided into the 'Kinki Area' and the 'Other' area. The Kinki Area comprises southern Kyoto Prefecture, Osaka Prefecture (excluding some areas), southern Hyogo Prefecture, Shiga Prefecture, Nara Prefecture (excluding some areas) and part of Mie Prefecture. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, track distance was 3,959.8 km, passenger-kilometers totaled 33,874,300 thousand passenger-km (Kinki Area 27,607,236 thousand passenger-km; Other 6,267,064 thousand passenger-km), and passenger revenue totaled ¥399,703 million (104.3% of the previous fiscal year), of which the Kinki Area accounted for ¥318,012 million and the Other area for ¥81,691 million. The occupancy rate was 37.0%. The securities report explains that conventional line transport revenue rose 4.3% year on year, an increase of ¥16.4 billion to ¥399.7 billion, and that Kinki Area revenue is affected by economic conditions, changes in work styles, and population trends including the declining birthrate, aging population and urbanization, while local line revenue is affected by competition with private cars, regional economic conditions and population trends. In March 2026, Tedoriyama Heiwa Koen Station opened between Himeji Station and Aboshi Station on the Sanyo Main Line.
entries.a1d9be422a481240: This reportable segment engages in travel agency operations and in proposing solutions to regional issues, and its main related company is Nippon Travel Agency Co., Ltd. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥189,203 million (up 0.2% year on year), segment profit was ¥529 million (¥1,133 million in the previous fiscal year), segment assets were ¥86,578 million, and capital expenditure was ¥700 million. The securities report explains that although the solutions business performed well and operating revenue rose 0.2% year on year to ¥189.2 billion, operating income fell 53.3% to ¥500 million due to increased costs, among other factors. It also worked on expanding content and strengthening sales of the travel plan 'tabiwa Travel', offered within the company's app.
entries.a8b0c9f3e42fbbdb: This category is carried out by JR West Trading Co., Ltd. According to its history, it is the entity formed after merging with JR West Finance Co., Ltd. in April 2009. Revenue and profit for this category alone are not disclosed in the securities report.
entries.a9db2f6869cb0ebd: This is the category the filing describes as a business segment not included in reportable segments, and it includes advertising and other businesses. In the table of business descriptions, the category lists advertising (JR West Communications Co., Ltd.), civil engineering and architectural consulting (JR West Consultants Co., Ltd.), spatial information consulting (Asia Air Survey Co., Ltd.) and information services (JR West IT Solutions Co., Ltd. and Railway Information Systems Co., Ltd.), among others, and Asia Air Survey Co., Ltd. and Railway Information Systems Co., Ltd. are equity-method affiliates. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, external revenue was ¥32,539 million (prior year: ¥31,413 million), segment profit was ¥5,410 million (prior year: ¥4,141 million), segment assets were ¥81,989 million, and capital expenditure was ¥3.2 billion. Because it is not a reportable segment, it is placed last rather than in order of revenue.
entries.b9dd9dd0f06bd3cc: This category is carried out by JR West Isetan Co., Ltd. Revenue and profit for this category alone are not disclosed in the securities report.
entries.cba9221dc793bc75: This category is carried out by JR West Real Estate Investment Advisory Co., Ltd. According to its history, it was established in July 2022. Revenue and profit for this category alone are not disclosed in the securities report.
entries.dc6c54de2b51af60: Various Works, Cleaning and Maintenance, and Construction
entries.ea273174415d42fc: This category sells goods and food and beverages within station premises and lists the company, JR West Daily Service Net Co., Ltd., JR West Food Service Net Co., Ltd., JR Service Net Hiroshima/Okayama/Kanazawa/Fukuoka Co., Ltd., and JR West Fashion Goods Co., Ltd. The securities report explains that, in addition to opening the Osaka-Kansai Expo Official Store and developing collaboration products, it advanced the expansion of partner stores with external companies and the development of regional products. Revenue and profit for this category alone are not disclosed in the securities report.
